subject: Difference of two binomial proportions in INLA

messages.author: 87db6da4a9a8d291
messages.subject: Difference of two binomial proportions in INLA
parts:
Dear INLA expert,

I was wondering if we can use INLA to measure the difference between two binomial proportions. Thanks in advance!

Best,
Alex

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Difference of two binomial proportions in INLA
parts:
library(INLA)
inla.setOption(inla.mode = "experimental")

n <- 20
N <- 2*n

Y <- matrix(NA, N, 2)
Y[1:n, 1] <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = 0.4)
Y[n + 1:n, 2] <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = 0.6)

p <- as.factor(rep(1:2, each = n))
r <- inla(Y ~ -1 + p,
data = list(Y = Y, p = p),
control.compute = list(config = TRUE),
family = rep("binomial", 2))

x <- inla.posterior.sample(10000, r)
pdiff <- inla.posterior.sample.eval(function() return(p1-p2), x)
hist(pdiff, n = 300, cex = 1)
